usedFor: Shopify holds your store, and Freelo gets a project when “Create Project” follows “New Product”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Project” in Freelo
bestTemplate.why: A new product opens a Freelo project, so photos, copy and launch tasks have a home.

watchOut: “Create Project” makes a new project every time, so give your products a naming rule you can find.
